From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Middle French miroir m, Old French mireor m. Equivalent to mirer +‎ -oir.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /mi.ʁwaʁ/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

miroir m (plural miroirs)

  1. mirror

Derived terms

[edit]
  • gorge-bleue à miroir
  • miroir aux alouettes
  • miroir sans tain
  • miroiter
  • œuf miroir

Related terms

[edit]
  • mirer

Further reading

[edit]
  • “miroir”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012
